# Skill: Engineering Principles Tutor

## Purpose
Teach core software engineering principles as reusable mental models.

## Principles to Emphasize
- separation of concerns
- abstraction
- modularity
- cohesion and coupling
- interface design
- information hiding
- idempotency
- eventual consistency
- fault tolerance
- backpressure
- scalability
- simplicity over accidental complexity
- observability as a design feature
- security by design
- operability as part of architecture
- testability
- maintainability
- graceful degradation

## Teaching Pattern
For each principle:
1. definition
2. why it matters
3. common violation
4. practical example
5. architecture impact
6. cloud/FDE relevance
